summary: Lakshmi Menon (CFO) emailed Rahul Verma about a discretionary spend freeze preventing a 36 L upfront payment. Rahul proposed starting the contract on July 1 with quarterly billing of 9 L per quarter and a free POC until then, keeping the annual price unchanged. Lakshmi accepted the proposal and asked for an order form dated July 1. The deal moves forward with the contract start date set, while the budget freeze remains a timing constraint.

objections.text: I can't sign thirty-six lakh upfront this quarter.
objections.how_handled: Offered quarterly billing of 9L per quarter and free POC, keeping annual price unchanged

buying_signals: CFO agreed to quarterly billing and free POC
CTO Karthik is keen on the solution
risk_signals: Discretionary spend freeze until Q3 (July) may delay signing
